panel.title: LibreNMS
panel.blurb: Devices your LibreNMS marks down: servers, sensors, and anything else it polls. With background checks on, the list is asked every minute even while this panel is closed. A notification is sent when a device goes offline or comes back, after the first check.
panel.refreshHelp: Ask LibreNMS again, once a minute, while the bar is running.
panel.notifyHelp: A desktop notification when a device goes offline or comes back.
panel.unconfigured: Add the LibreNMS address and an API token. The token is kept in a file only this plugin reads.
panel.invalid: Enter the http or https address of your LibreNMS.
panel.tokenInvalid: The token should be the long string LibreNMS shows when you create an API token.
panel.saveFailed: The address and token could not be saved.
notify.headline: LibreNMS
notify.body: Device status changed. Open the LibreNMS panel for details.
error.resolve: The LibreNMS name did not resolve.
error.auth: LibreNMS refused the token or the address.
error.large: The reply was larger than this panel will read.
error.parse: LibreNMS did not return a device list.
error.api: LibreNMS did not return a device list.
